G1354.name: Dionysius
G1354.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1354.brief: Areopagite who believed Paul's message in Athens
G1354.short: Dionysius the Areopagite was one of the people who believed Paul's message when he preached in Athens.

G1361.name: Diotrephes
G1361.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G1361.short: Diotrephes was a church leader who loved to be first and refused to welcome John and his companions.
